For pull-based sources like OTel trace and OTel metrics, OpenSearch Ingestion requires the
additional path option in your source conﬁguration. The path is a string such as /log/ingest,
which represents the URI path for ingestion. This path deﬁnes the URI that you use to send data to
the pipeline.
For example, say you specify the following path for a pipeline with an HTTP source:
Specifying the ingestion path
73
Amazon OpenSearch Service
Developer Guide
When you ingest data into the pipeline, you must specify the following
endpoint in your client conﬁguration: https://pipeline-name-abc123.us-
west-2.osis.amazonaws.com/my/test_path.
The path must start with a slash (/) and can contain the special characters '-', '_', '.', and '/',
as well as the ${pipelineName} placeholder. If you use ${pipelineName} (such as /
${pipelineName}/test_path), OpenSearch Ingestion replaces the variable with the name of
the associated sub-pipeline.
